description: Phase 6 binding accuracy fixture. Each triple is (cite text, citing module, expected section-ref target). Spans the 4 affected modules (sf-plumbing, sf-building, sf-housing, sf-charter) plus 5 unaffected control modules (sf-administrative, sf-business, sf-elections, sf-police, sf-port). Patterns covered: intra-module, cross-module suffix-form, cross-module prefix-form (CA codes), multi-code paragraph, structural references, alpha-suffix, strip-trailing-zero, sibling-fallback, vague reclassification. Tests against the live binder via test/parser/binding-accuracy.test.ts; targets the binder layer per feedback_test_each_path_once.
